Path 2, authorizationGOALS §3.6

Cedar and OpenFGA

Answering 'what can this agent actually do?' with a query.

WHAT IT IS

Cedar: AWS's open policy language, designed to be analysed, so you can prove what a policy allows. OpenFGA: a CNCF relationship-based authorization engine on Google's Zanzibar model.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Cedar's analysability is the point for MCP: AWS and Stacklok showed proving what an agent's tool permissions allow. OpenFGA fits permissions that follow relationships: teams, ownership, sharing.

WHERE WE STAND

Trial Cedar for MCP tool permissions alongside the Obot and ToolHive bake-off.

"What Can Your AI Agents Actually Do? Cedar Analysis for MCP Servers" (AWS, Stacklok), KubeCon NA 2026

TRIAL

Cedar and OpenFGA: Answering 'what can this agent actually do?' with a query. Where we stand: Trial Cedar for MCP tool permissions alongside the Obot and ToolHive bake-off. The question to answer in one query: list every tool this agent can call, and with what scope.
